generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A candidate can appear internally healthy when evidence is bound to the wrong semantic contract or to an incomplete canonical-gate state, even though the literal check looks plausible.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a nearby metric or a focused validation as equivalent to the canonical contract, then publish readiness without proving the exact semantic boundary and final gate inventory.
trigger_signals: focused validation substituted for canonical gate
two related measurements use different coordinate or identity domains
ready state produced while final evidence is pending or stale

reusable_control.procedure: Bind each material assertion to its exact semantic domain and bind readiness to the complete canonical gate inventory; represent unavailable final evidence as pending instead of inferring equivalence.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Do not replace an exact semantic metric or canonical final gate with a nearby proxy, ancestor result, or focused check when constructing a ready candidate.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Adversarial verification must vary the semantic domain and gate state independently and prove that proxy metrics or incomplete evidence cannot satisfy the final contract.

transfer_cases.evidence: A synthetic layout check distinguishes outer viewport width from content-box width and accounts for excluded scrollbar width explicitly.
A synthetic delivery check keeps readiness non-green when the exact final canonical gate is pending, failed, or only observed on an ancestor.

skill_changes.change: Applied the existing exact-material and canonical-gate readiness contract to the current remediation; no repository-specific rule was promoted.
Retained independent validation of semantic evidence and canonical gate state as the detection boundary for the next audit.
